第二十八章 阴风锁山预埋绝杀符（第1页）
残阳彻底沉入连绵群山尽头，厚重乌云压满整片天穹，天光转瞬尽数消散，幽深阴冷的夜色，彻底笼罩住整片后山密林。
深秋寒风穿林而过，卷起满地枯黄落叶，林间风声呼啸，四下寂静无声。
这片后山地处宗门后方腹地，远离前线两大势力交战战场，常年安稳太平，平日里只有低阶妖兽出没，几乎不会遇上修士厮杀，宗门派驻在此的值守弟子，向来戒备松散，无人会料到祸事会骤然降临。
本轮值守人员固定不变，没有任何新增人物。
小队领队苏晚晴，筑基中期修为，冷静沉稳，统筹整片后山所有警戒防务与人员轮换；赵磊主修肉身横练功法，体魄坚硬力量强横，负责正面抵挡强敌攻势；许巧精通疗伤丹粉与驱煞药剂，专职救治伤员、化解阴邪尸毒；陈默观察力敏锐，擅长利用地形布置后手，行事素来谨慎；外围哨岗由同门周默值守，负责整片山林第一道外围警戒防线。
除此之外，陈默怀中始终藏着一只通体雪白的灵狐。
这灵狐看着身形娇小，皮毛如雪，平日里安安静静蜷缩在陈默衣襟之内，从不外露气息，看似温顺无害，实则修为深不可测，战力远超在场所有值守弟子，只是一向不喜张扬，始终隐匿身形，默默跟在陈默身边，暗中护他周全。
陈默腰间佩着一柄阴魂剑，剑身漆黑古朴，敛尽全部灵力锋芒，看上去与普通凡铁长剑别无二致，无人知晓这柄古剑暗藏克制天下尸邪的诡异力量。他身侧挂着一枚蓝纹储物袋，袋中存放疾风符、土墙符、烈火符等常用基础符箓，还有一张三阶绝杀埋伏符，符箓杀力霸道，可瞬间封锁整片区域重创敌人，是陈默压箱底的底牌，非生死绝境绝不会动用。
夜幕彻底降临，山林气息莫名异变。
往日入夜之后，林间虫鸣兽吼不绝，山野生机盎然，可今夜整片密林死寂一片，所有鸟兽尽数仓皇逃窜，消失无踪。一缕冰冷阴寒的尸煞雾气，悄无声息从密林深处弥漫开来，这股气息陌生暴戾，不属于前线交战任何一方势力，也不在宗门邪修通缉名册之中，来路诡异，毫无踪迹可寻。
陈默察觉到空气中异常的阴冷煞气，起身走出值守木屋，逐一勘察后山三条必经山道，最终选定正中狭窄隘口。此处两侧岩壁陡峭，通道狭窄逼仄，敌人进入之后无处躲闪迂回，能将绝杀埋伏符的威力发挥到极致。
他俯身拨开地面腐叶与湿泥，将绝杀埋伏符平整深埋地底，再仔细回填泥土，复原地表杂草落叶，彻底抹去所有埋伏痕迹。
符箓深埋地下，灵力彻底沉寂，哪怕筑基巅峰修士全力神识探查，也无法察觉地底暗藏杀机。
做完这一切，陈默转身返回木屋闭目调息，怀中白狐依旧安静蛰伏，周身气息完全收敛，与周遭夜色融为一体。
木屋内外一切如常，山林平静无风，林间没有黑影晃动，没有黑雾外泄，没有陌生脚步声靠近，没有任何外敌来袭的征兆。
谁都不曾知晓，致命危机已然潜伏在无边黑暗之中，一场毫无预兆、毫无铺垫的突袭，下一刻便会骤然爆发。

>Chapter 28: Yinfengsuo Mountain pre-buried the killing talisman (page 1)
Chapter 28: Yinfengsuo Mountain has buried the ultimate talisman (page 1)
The setting sun completely sank into the end of the rolling mountains, thick dark clouds filled the sky, all the skylight disappeared in an instant, and the deep and cold night completely enveloped the entire dense forest in the back mountains.
The cold wind in late autumn passed through the forest, rolling up the yellow and fallen leaves all over the ground. The wind whistled in the forest, and there was silence everywhere.
This back mountain is located in the hinterland behind the sect, far away from the battlefield where the two major forces on the front line are fighting. It is stable and peaceful all year round. On weekdays, only low-level monsters come and go, and there are almost no monks fighting. The disciples on duty stationed here by the sect have always been loosely guarded, and no one would have expected that disaster would suddenly come.
The personnel on duty this round are fixed and there are no new characters.
The leader of the team, Su Wanqing, is in the middle stage of foundation building. She is calm and steady, coordinating all security defenses and personnel rotations in the entire back mountain; Zhao Lei specializes in physical horizontal training techniques, has a strong body and strong strength, and is responsible for resisting powerful enemy offensives; Xu Qiao is proficient in healing wounds Dan powder and evil-dispelling potions are dedicated to treating the wounded and neutralizing the evil corpse poison; Chen Mo has keen observation, is good at using the terrain to arrange backup, and always acts cautiously; the outer sentry post is guarded by fellow sect Zhou Mo, who is responsible for the first outer warning line of defense in the entire mountain forest.
In addition, there is always a snow-white spirit fox hidden in Chen Mo's arms.
This spirit fox looked petite, with fur as thick as snow. It usually curled up quietly in Chen Mo's clothes and never showed its breath. It seemed docile and harmless, but in fact its cultivation was unfathomable, and its combat power far exceeded all the disciples on duty. However, it never liked to show off, and always kept its figure hidden, silently following Chen Mo, and secretly protecting him.
Chen Mo wore a Yinhun Sword on his waist. The blade was dark and simple, gathering all the spiritual energy and edge. It looked just like an ordinary iron long sword. No one knew that this ancient sword concealed the strange power of restraining the evil spirits in the world. There is a blue-patterned storage bag hanging on his side, which contains commonly used basic talismans such as the Wind Talisman, Earth Wall Talisman, and Fire Talisman, as well as a third-level ambush talisman. The talisman is extremely lethal and can instantly block the entire area and severely damage the enemy. It is Chen Mo's trump card, and he will never use it unless he is in a desperate situation.
Night has completely fallen, and the atmosphere of the mountains and forests has changed inexplicably.
In the past, after nightfall, the forest was buzzing with insects and beasts, and the mountains were full of life. But tonight, the entire dense forest was completely silent, and all the birds and beasts fled in panic and disappeared without a trace. A wisp of cold and cold zombie mist spread silently from the depths of the dense forest. This breath was strange and violent. It did not belong to any of the forces fighting on the front line, nor was it on the wanted list of the evil cultivators of the sect. It came from a strange place and had no trace.
Chen Mo noticed the unusual coldness and evil in the air. He stood up and walked out of the wooden house on duty. He inspected the three must-pass mountain roads in the back mountain one by one, and finally selected the narrow pass in the middle. The rock walls on both sides here are steep and the passage is narrow and constricted. The enemy has nowhere to dodge after entering, which can maximize the power of the ultimate ambush talisman.
He leaned over and pushed aside the rotten leaves and wet mud on the ground, flattened the killing ambush talisman and buried it deep into the ground. He then carefully backfilled the soil and restored the weeds and fallen leaves on the surface, completely erasing all traces of the ambush.
The talisman was buried deep in the ground, and its spiritual power was completely silent. Even if the monks at the peak of the Foundation Establishment tried their best to explore with their spiritual consciousness, they could not detect the murderous intention hidden underground.
After doing all this, Chen Mo turned back to the wooden house and closed his eyes to adjust his breathing. The white fox in his arms was still dormant quietly, and the aura around him was completely restrained, blending into the surrounding night.
Everything was as usual inside and outside the wooden house, the forest was calm and windless, there were no black shadows shaking in the forest, no black mist leaking out, no unfamiliar footsteps approaching, and no signs of any foreign enemy coming.
No one knew that a fatal crisis was already lurking in the boundless darkness. An unexpected and unprepared surprise attack.It will suddenly explode in a moment.
